audience: shippers that send parcels through their own Boxtal account

useCases.title: Find a parcel point near a customer
useCases.text: Search the parcel pickup and drop-off points near an address. Limit the search to the networks you choose.

useCases.title: Check an order and its tracking
useCases.text: Read a shipping order for its status and dates. Then read the tracking history of its packages.

useCases.title: Get the shipping documents of an order
useCases.text: List the shipping documents of an order, such as the label or the CN23 form, with their download URLs.

useCases.title: Create a shipment after approval
useCases.text: Read the content categories that the order accepts. After the user approves the shipment, create and order it. Boxtal bills the order to the account.

useCases.title: Cancel a shipping order
useCases.text: Cancel a shipping order when the user asks. The cancel can fail once the carrier has taken the parcel.
